whatsupHouse.title: The Whatsup House Story
whatsupHouse.description: Whatsup House is a small offline social gathering platform planned and hosted directly by its founder so people in their 20s and 30s living alone can meet without pressure.

sections.heading: What is Whatsup House?
sections.body: We wanted to make evenings feel less lonely, even when you live alone. Whatsup House is an offline social gathering platform for one-person households in their 20s and 30s. We create easygoing moments where people can meet and share tastes and everyday stories.

sections.heading: The gatherings we create
sections.body: Every gathering is planned and hosted directly by Whatsup House. Each one is kept small, with up to 20 people, so first-time guests can settle in naturally.

sections.heading: How to join
sections.body: Browse gatherings you like and apply. No complicated matching, just join a gathering on the date that works for you.
